<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="22" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="19" x2="326" y2="15" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="19" x2="331" y2="12" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="19" x2="336" y2="9" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="18" x2="354" y2="21" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="360" y="10" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="13" width="17" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="385" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="39,51 31,59 39,67" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="59" x2="52" y2="59" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Profile Setup</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="105" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">Complete your profile to personalize your news experience.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile photo -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="122" width="342" height="94" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="76" cy="169" r="33" fill="#EEF1F4" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="160" r="9" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <ellipse cx="76" cy="182" rx="17" ry="10" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <circle cx="103" cy="195" r="12" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <line x1="103" y1="189" x2="103" y2="201" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="97" y1="195" x2="109" y2="195" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="130" y="164" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Profile photo</text>
    <text x="130" y="188" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#A0A3BD">Add a photo so people know you</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Username field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="242" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="250" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="280" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">@alexmorgan</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="274" r="8" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <polyline points="341,274 344,277 350,270" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Full name field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="325" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Full name</text>
    <rect x="24" y="333" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="363" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">Alex Morgan</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Email field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="408" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Email address</text>
    <rect x="24" y="416" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="446" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">alex.morgan@email.com</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="440" r="8" fill="#00BA88"/>
    <polyline points="341,440 344,443 350,436" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Phone field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="491" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Phone number</text>
    <rect x="24" y="499" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="36" y="529" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">+1 415 555 0198</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile preferences summary -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="574" width="342" height="70" rx="6" fill="#FAFAFA"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="609" r="16" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <polygon points="40,615 46,606 50,610 54,604 58,615" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="603" r="3" fill="#F4B740"/>
    <text x="76" y="603" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Your profile is almost ready</text>
    <text x="76" y="624" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">You can update these details anytime.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Fixed next button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="679" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#0D5FCC" opacity=".13"/>
    <rect x="24" y="677" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    <polyline points="215,702 221,708 215,714" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="790" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="48,783 51,790 48,797 45,790" fill="#667080"/>
    <text x="48" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    <!-- Bookmarks -->
    <polygon points="141,780 155,780 155,799 148,795 141,799" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="148" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="236,787 246,779 256,787" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="239" y="786" width="14" height="13" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="246" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#667080">Home</text>
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <circle cx="338" cy="786" r="5" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <ellipse cx="338" cy="798" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="338" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Genuine compound icon paths -->
  <path d="M68 169 C68 164 72 160 76 160 C80 160 84 164 84 169" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M61 185 C64 177 70 174 76 174 C82 174 88 177 91 185" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M30 59 L39 50" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M30 59 L39 68" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M354 790 C354 786 351 783 347 783 C343 783 340 786 340 790 C340 794 343 797 347 797 C351 797 354 794 354 790 Z" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1"/>
</svg>
